criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Ordering and Delivery
categories.definition: Inquiries regarding ordering a new card, delivery status, card types available, or eligibility to receive a card.

categories.name: Card Expiration and Replacement
categories.definition: Inquiries about cards nearing expiration, requesting replacement cards, or reactivating found cards.

categories.name: Card Usage and Acceptance
categories.definition: Questions about where the card is accepted, usage limits, or general functionality of card types like disposable or virtual cards.

categories.name: Card Not Working or Declined
categories.definition: Reports of a card being declined, failing to work at terminals or ATMs, or issues with contactless payments.

categories.name: Card Security and Stolen Card
categories.definition: Reports of lost or stolen cards, requests to freeze or block a card immediately, or concerns about unauthorized card possession.

categories.name: PIN Management
categories.definition: Requests to change, reset, or unblock a PIN, or issues regarding forgotten PINs or PIN entry errors.

categories.name: Top Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems with adding money to the account, including failed, pending, or reverted top-up transactions.

categories.name: Top Up General Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about available top-up methods, limits, fees, or how to use specific top-up features like Apple Pay or cheques.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Problems with sending or receiving transfers, including failed, pending, or missing transactions.

categories.name: Transfer General Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about how to make a transfer, transfer limits, processing times, or fees associated with transfers.

categories.name: Exchange Rates and Currency
categories.definition: Questions about current exchange rates, supported currencies, or how currency exchange works.

categories.name: Exchange and ATM Transaction Disputes
categories.definition: Disputes regarding incorrect exchange rates applied to transactions or incorrect cash amounts received from ATMs.

categories.name: ATM Withdrawal Issues
categories.definition: Reports of being unable to withdraw cash from an ATM or the ATM capturing the card.

categories.name: Fee Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions asking why a specific fee was charged or requesting information about general service fees and costs.

categories.name: Transaction Disputes and Fraud
categories.definition: Reports of unrecognized, duplicate, or unauthorized transactions, or requests to dispute a merchant charge.

categories.name: Payment Cancellation and Refunds
categories.definition: Requests to cancel a pending payment or transfer, or inquiries about the status of a refund.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions about the identity verification process, required documents, or issues with verification failure.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests to update personal details, change account settings, or close an account.

categories.name: App Access and Security
categories.definition: Issues related to logging in, lost phones, forgotten passwords, or general app security concerns.
